justification: Constraint arithmetic engine + lot dimensions port + shadow continuous function + contributions integration. Produces user-facing yield/binding-constraint outputs and wires new data sources into intelligence brief pipeline.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads from DevelopmentBrief models (PlanningControls, DCPControls, SEPPStandard, SeppLepOverride, ShadowResult, LotDimensions). No DB queries. Lot geometry from Portal /lot API. Contributions from Portal /cp API.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If height/FSR strings have unexpected format, _parse_numeric returns None and gap is disclosed. If DCP control_type names don't match expected keys, controls are skipped and gap disclosed. If lot geometry has <4 points, returns None. If /cp returns empty, contributions field is NOT_AVAILABLE.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: constraint_arithmetic.py and lot_dimensions.py are new pure-function modules. intelligence_brief.py modified to wire lot geometry, contributions, and import new modules.
pre_impl.external_source_error: fetch_lot_geometry: try/except returns None on failure. _fetch_contributions: try/except returns None on failure. Both wrapped in _safe_call in pipeline.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend changes. ContributionsResult, ContributionPlan, HousingProductivityContribution are new Pydantic models — frontend will need types when wired.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If any computation fails, ConstraintArithmeticResult with confidence='low' and populated gaps[] is returned. Lot dimensions None = area-only fallback. Contributions None = NOT_AVAILABLE DataField. No crash, no silent wrong answer.

functions.name: compute_constraint_arithmetic
functions.input: lot_area_m2: float, dev_type: str, lep_height_str/lep_fsr_str: Optional[str], lot_dimensions: Optional[LotDimensions], dcp_controls: list[DCPControl], sepp_standards: list[SEPPStandard], sepp_lep_overrides: list[SeppLepOverride], shadow_result: Optional[ShadowResult]
functions.output: ConstraintArithmeticResult Pydantic model containing binding_constraint enum, realistic_dwellings int, computation steps chain list, gaps list, and confidence level string
functions.if_none: Each None input adds a gap entry to the result. Zero data produces confidence 'low' with no yield computed.

functions.name: calculate_lot_dimensions
functions.input: Optional dict geometry containing rings key with nested EPSG:3857 coordinate arrays from NSW Planning Portal
functions.output: Optional LotDimensions Pydantic model with area_m2, frontage_m, depth_m, and is_corner fields populated from polygon
functions.if_none: Returns None if geometry is None, rings list is empty, first ring is empty, or fewer than 3 unique points after closing-point dedup

functions.name: fetch_lot_geometry
functions.input: prop_id string representing the NSW Planning Portal property ID used to query the lot endpoint
functions.output: Optional dict containing raw geometry with rings key in EPSG:3857, or None on any failure
functions.if_none: Returns None on network error, HTTP error, empty response list, or missing geometry key in response

functions.name: _fetch_contributions
functions.input: prop_id integer for the NSW Planning Portal property used to query the contributions plan endpoint
functions.output: Optional ContributionsResult Pydantic model containing s7.12 plan names with PDF URLs and optional HPC overlay details
functions.if_none: Returns None on network error, HTTP error, or when response contains no contribution plans and no HPC overlay

functions.name: _build_planning_controls
functions.input: controls dict from portal, overlays_data dict from PostGIS, and optional lot_geometry dict from Portal lot endpoint
functions.output: PlanningControls Pydantic model with lot_dimensions now populated with frontage_m and depth_m from polygon geometry when available
functions.if_none: If lot_geometry is None or calculate_lot_dimensions returns None, falls back to area-only LotDimensions parsed from lot_size string

functions.name: _identify_binding_constraint
functions.input: GFA values from FSR and height paths, setback-only footprint, final footprint, max storeys, coverage cap, landscaping reduction, shadow flag, and lot area
functions.output: Optional tuple of ConstraintType enum value and human-readable label string identifying the single most limiting constraint
functions.if_none: Returns None if no constraint candidates exist, meaning no data was available to compute any constraint path

values.if_missing: N/A — always 1.0 when lot dimensions or shadow length unavailable

break_it.scenario: Lot geometry with 3 points (triangle + closing) — valid or rejected?
break_it.what_happens: 4 points in ring, closing point removed, 3 unique points remain — valid polygon, area computed via shoelace
break_it.how: services/lot_dimensions.py:62 — len(rings[0]) < 4 rejects, but triangle with closing = 4 points passes. Shoelace handles 3-point polygon correctly.

break_it.scenario: Circular import between lot_dimensions.py and intelligence_brief.py at module load time
break_it.what_happens: ImportError raised during module collection preventing any test or runtime from loading
break_it.how: lot_dimensions.py uses TYPE_CHECKING guard for top-level import, deferred runtime import inside calculate_lot_dimensions()
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_lot_dimensions.py — would fail at collection if circular import existed

break_it.scenario: Noon scenario has lower overlap than morning — which is used?
break_it.what_happens: Noon overlap preferred over worst-case. If noon is 15% (below 20% MIN), no reduction even if morning is 80%
break_it.how: services/constraint_arithmetic.py:508 — noon_overlap used when available, worst_overlap only as fallback

break_it.what_happens: _fetch_contributions handles gracefully — .get('cp') returns None, or {} returns None, empty plans list
break_it.repro: Manual: curl with invalid prop_id returns empty results, not error

break_it.scenario: Shadow depth_amplifier exceeds cap when shadow_length >> lot_depth
break_it.what_happens: depth_amplifier has min(0.25, ...) cap, and final shadow_gfa_loss has min(..., max_shadow_loss) cap
break_it.how: services/constraint_arithmetic.py:526 — min(0.25, ...) caps amplifier; line 531 — min(..., max_shadow_loss) caps total loss

post_merge.manual_verify: No — pure computation + data fetch wiring. Full test coverage (103 new tests).
